subject.declared_domain: The RELATION vocabulary of the archetype layer: ten agnostic, plain-English relation names (produces, consumes, derives-from, depends-on, contains, triggers, guards, governs, denies, owns), each declaring the physical graph edge_types that bind up to it. It is the vocabulary half of the C1 rung -- C1 is the live edge population, this block is the legislated naming over it.

methodology.how: A hand-legislated YAML block, top-level key `relations:` at line 136 of the rule bank. Each of the ten members is a mapping whose load-bearing field is `binds_up: [PHYSICAL_EDGE_TYPE, ...]` -- the declared join from the agnostic relation name DOWN to the concrete edge_types the derive runner emits. Several members also carry a free-text `note` recording why a given physical type was admitted. Nothing computes this block; it changes only by a ratification act plus a `meta.version` bump. It is DECLARED, never discovered -- the inverse of the C1 population it names, which is discovered and never declared.
declared_opinions: WHICH physical edge_types bind to which relation -- 47 such assignments across the 10 members, each a judgement call with no mechanical derivation. Example: CALLS, RUNS and INVOKES are all bound to `triggers` rather than to `produces` or `depends-on`.

That `RENDERS` binds to `consumes` -- the block's own note records the tension: JSXRender is role=Sink (inbound-consumes) while the outbound RENDERS edge is the read it consumes. The note calls the direction nuance 'recorded, not a blocker'.

That two relations (`governs`, `denies`) are declared with a single physical binding each (GOVERNS, DENIED) that has ZERO live instances -- the vocabulary anticipates edges the estate does not currently emit.

The agnostic-vocabulary choice itself: relation names are plain English and substrate-neutral, so an AWS-specific edge and a Microsoft-365-specific edge can bind to the same relation. That is a deliberate abstraction and it is the reason the block cannot be derived from the graph.

C1 stated '31 of 53 live edge_types, carrying 20,703 of 58,224 edges (35.6%), are bound by no declared block'. THAT IS FALSE. I built C1's declared universe from the block KEYS (produces, consumes, ...) and never opened the members, so the 47 physical names inside binds_up were invisible to me. Reading the members gives 53 of 53 mapped, 100%. Spot-checked the four I would most doubt, each resolving to a structured field rather than a note string: OWNED_BY -> relations.owns.binds_up; CALLS -> relations.triggers.binds_up; HAS_FIELD and CLUSTERS -> relations.contains.binds_up. A BLOCK'S KEYS ARE NOT ITS CONTENTS.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: The block is passive data, so its failure surfaces at the CONSUMER. Every one of the 8 consumers performs the same shape: yaml.safe_load then a dict lookup. On a miss the lookup returns None -- silently. A relation name that does not exist and a physical edge_type the block has not bound are both simply absent, and the consumer receives the same None for each.
silent_degrade_paths: the stale v1.1 duplicate carries its own `relations:` block and the IDENTICAL `ratified: LD-0311 @086238604` string -- a consumer that resolved to it would read an authoritative-looking provenance from a seven-version-stale vocabulary. RATIFICATION IDENTITY DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE VINTAGE. No consumer does resolve to it today.
an edge_type emitted by the derive runner but never added to any binds_up is invisible to every relation-keyed traversal, which returns a smaller, confident, well-formed answer rather than an error
the block has no cadence, so it can fall behind a nightly-moving estate indefinitely with nothing signalling the gap
a relation declared with a physical binding that has zero live edges (governs, denies) is indistinguishable, from inside the block, from one whose edges merely have not been emitted yet
failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED, THREE ARMS, on the lookup shape every consumer uses. Inverting the block and querying: ARM A a declared name -> resolves (positive control, the lookup CAN answer); ARM B a live edge_type not bound by this block -> None; ARM C a nonexistent token -> None. ARMS B AND C ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL, which is the finding. Arm A establishes the probe is live, so the two Nones are answers rather than a dead instrument. The stale-duplicate path is measured rather than hypothesised: both meta.ratified strings read `LD-0311 @086238604` while meta.version reads 1.8 and 1.1. NOT EXERCISED, and named as such: I did not repoint a consumer at the duplicate to watch it succeed -- that would be a mutation of another seat's code and qualify-do-not-fix binds. The path is structural and its precondition (0 consumers) is measured.

verdict.why: All seven rows are worked and carry basis, evidence, owner and basis_by_field; none is blank or guessed, so this is not INCOMPLETE. The block is SOUND in the one way that matters most and was doubted until now: its declared mapping to the live edge population is COMPLETE -- 53 of 53 edge_types, 58,224 of 58,224 edges -- and my wave-1 C1 card was wrong to say otherwise. It is QUALIFIED rather than SOUND on three measured limits, none of which blocks use: (1) NO CADENCE and no producer, so a legislated vocabulary sits against an estate that moves nightly with nothing reconciling them on a schedule; (2) 2 of 10 relations and 11 of 47 declared physical bindings have ZERO live edges, so the vocabulary's own exercise rate is unmeasured territory a consumer should not assume; (3) a lookup miss returns a silent None indistinguishable from a genuine absence, exercised over three arms. A fourth item is recorded and is NOT a defect of this block: a stale v1.1 duplicate exists in a deliverables tree carrying the same ratification string, and no consumer reads it. NOT CLAIMED: that the 47 bindings are semantically CORRECT. This card measured that the mapping is COMPLETE and that its members are live; whether CALLS truly belongs under `triggers` rather than `produces` is a judgement this card records as a declared opinion and does not adjudicate. NO DEPRECATION VERDICT is expressed or implied, per W2-m-3.
